title: The browser certificate warning — question explanation
learningObjective: Respond safely to browser certificate and security warnings
format: 16:9 educational motion-graphics video; narration; separate captions; no autoplay with sound
visualStyle: Deep navy and charcoal; restrained cyan/electric-blue highlights; limited purple accents; clean typography; purposeful, low-motion transitions; accessible contrast.

scenes.name: Scenario setup
scenes.visual: While opening a site to pay a fee, the browser displays a certificate warning and says the connection may not be private.
scenes.direction: Show a fictional simulated setting. Use generic UI and no actual organization, brand, user identity, credential, real URL or live account.

scenes.name: Learning objective and risk cue
scenes.visual: Respond safely to browser certificate and security warnings
scenes.direction: Highlight only observable cues and explain the decision context without implying certainty beyond the scenario.

scenes.name: Recommended response
scenes.visual: Option C: Stop and access the service later through its known official address or contact its support team. Do not bypass a browser security warning for a sensitive transaction; verify independently.
scenes.direction: Animate the recommended defensive choice as a clear decision path. Display the action verb and trusted channel/control.

scenes.name: Why the other options fail
scenes.visual: Option A: A familiar-looking page does not resolve a certificate or connection warning. Option B: Disabling protections increases exposure and is not an appropriate way to complete a payment. Option D: Repeated attempts do not establish that the site is trustworthy.
scenes.direction: Show each unsafe alternative separately with a complete, concise reason. Do not depict operational exploitation, malicious code or credential capture.

scenes.name: Defensive takeaway
scenes.visual: Close the page, avoid entering credentials or payment data, and verify the service through a known official route. Do not bypass a security warning to complete a sensitive task.
scenes.direction: Close with one readable takeaway and the next safe action. Keep the final frame long enough for comprehension.
scenes.onScreenText: Do not bypass a security warning to complete a sensitive task.

narration: Scenario: While opening a site to pay a fee, the browser displays a certificate warning and says the connection may not be private. Safest response: Option C: Stop and access the service later through its known official address or contact its support team. Do not bypass a browser security warning for a sensitive transaction; verify independently. Option A is unsafe because A familiar-looking page does not resolve a certificate or connection warning. Option B is unsafe because Disabling protections increases exposure and is not an appropriate way to complete a payment. Option D is unsafe because Repeated attempts do not establish that the site is trustworthy. In practice: Close the page, avoid entering credentials or payment data, and verify the service through a known official route. Key takeaway: Do not bypass a security warning to complete a sensitive task.
